title: Discovery of DMT's effects by Stephen Szára, who injected himself and then colleagues

tellings.quote: DMT was discovered in 1956 by this Hungarian physician uh called Steven Zara.

plain: DMT, a short-acting and very powerful psychedelic compound, first had its effects on the mind found in 1956 by a Hungarian physician named Stephen Szára, who injected himself with it in a hospital and then gave it to colleagues. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore tells this as a summary of the drug's history, without naming a source: "DMT was discovered in 1956 by this Hungarian physician." He tells it because it marks where the modern study of the drug's strange visions begins.
